notes.title: Arenus: Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=CAcyvL5AZ0E;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey folks!

The last months, the last year were crazy.  A journey of self-discovery, how to handle the pressure of creating something unique, to break even and to fullfill our promises.

But we're finally feeling comfortable pushing Arenus to it's release! This is also because we've got a talented Coder on board now who's helping us with technical issues.  

Next month we'll be releasing the official demo for Arenus... 

...and in June/July the final release!

Stay tuned!

- Kal
